What these are: the answers of a cheap model (haiku) to the probe's tasks, kept by
`scry_core.probe --capture` from a probe run, one file per task under `captured/<server>/`. The
probe test re-judges each against today's tools, so a capture records an answer once given; it is
not a reply of the emulator.
The captures of d152, d192, d193 and d195 to d197 are answers of sonnet at low effort.
